description: Draw 1 to 3 twist cards: short provocations that push a project somewhere unexpected (a constraint, a point of view, a cross with something far away). Use it when an idea feels flat. Some cards name a real style, room or piece from the museum.

visitor_name.description: Your name as a visitor (max 40 chars). The same name always gives the same avatar, stamps and badges. Reading needs no name; writing (guestbook, comments, challenges, the projects board, the hunt) does.
